title: 88 Nic Spearmint Nicotine Pouches
description: 88Nic Spearmint tastes cool and mellow, pairing the gentle sweetness of Spearmint with a smooth, minty lift. The flavour remains rounded and clean with a lightly cooling finish. Each pouch sits neatly under the lip, releasing nicotine gradually without smoke, vapour or odour. Each can includes 20 pouches. Choose from 6mg (Medium) for a softer release or 12mg (Extra Strong) for a more pronounced dose. The format is simple to use and designed for everyday convenience. Nicotine Ranges: Medium - 6mg this is best for regular users. Extra Strong - 12mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Nicotine Pouches Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
